name: terminal
description: Sandboxed terminal/script execution (B5): commands run in a restricted subprocess (no shell interpolation, working dir confined to the project, output capped, timeout enforced). An allow-list (Settings -> Skills -> terminal_allow) decides what may run; a deny-list is always refused; anything that changes the system asks first (T2). Read-only commands (status, list, version, diff) run without confirmation.
route: run a command, execute a script, git status, run pytest, terminal
